_readme: Copy this to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Mise\print-agent.json and fill it in. NEVER save it inside this repository: GitHub Pages serves everything in here, so a password saved beside the code would be published on the web the moment somebody committed it.
password: the password of the dedicated printing account
_locationId: The venue this computer prints for. It is the id in the Firebase console under `locations`, e.g. `bakery` — not the name on screen.
_printer_share: mode 'share' is a printer plugged into THIS computer. Share it in Windows first, then put the share's full name here. Raw bytes are copied to the share, which bypasses the driver's rendering — that is the whole point, because a driver would print the ZPL codes as text instead of the label.
_printer_tcp: mode 'tcp' is a printer with its own address on the network. Replace the whole `printer` block above with this one: { "mode": "tcp", "host": "192.168.1.50", "port": 9100 }
